ds_delivery.name: Rack delivery
ds_delivery.sql: select f.rack_id, f.ordered_at, f.shipped_at, f.received_at, f.cabled_at, f.production_at, f.decommissioned_at, f.vendor_lead_hours, f.transit_hours, f.install_hours, f.burn_in_hours, f.end_to_end_hours, f.current_status, f.current_status_since, f.days_in_current_status, f.sla_days, f.sla_due_at, case when f.is_sla_breached then 1 else 0 end as is_sla_breached, case when f.is_overdue_open then 1 else 0 end as is_overdue_open, f.regression_count, v.vendor_code, v.vendor_name, v.contract_tier, s.site_code, s.site_name, s.site_region, t.rack_type_code, t.description as rack_type_description, case when t.is_gpu then 1 else 0 end as is_gpu from marts.fct_rack_delivery f left join marts.dim_vendor v on f.vendor_sk = v.vendor_sk left join marts.dim_site s on f.site_sk = s.site_sk left join marts.dim_rack_type t on f.rack_type_sk = t.rack_type_sk

ds_cycle_monthly.name: Cycle time by month
ds_cycle_monthly.sql: select month, vendor_code, site_code, stage, p50_hours, p90_hours, mean_hours, rack_count from marts.agg_cycle_time_monthly

ds_throughput.name: Daily throughput
ds_throughput.sql: select date, site_code, racks_to_production, racks_to_production_7d_avg, open_wip from marts.agg_daily_throughput

ds_pipeline_health.name: Pipeline health
ds_pipeline_health.sql: select run_id, started_at, finished_at, status, ingest_date_min, ingest_date_max, rows_landed, rows_loaded_raw, rows_quarantined, rows_fct_event_merged, late_event_count, dbt_tests_passed, dbt_tests_warned, dbt_tests_failed, redshift_charged_seconds, est_cost_usd, cast(rows_quarantined as double precision) / nullif(rows_landed, 0) as quarantine_rate from ops.pipeline_run_audit
